name: fix_cancel_rebooking_releases_booking_20260822
query: create or replace function public.admin_set_booking_status(p_booking_id bigint, p_status text, p_password text) returns boolean language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ declare target_date date; target_time time; begin if p_password <> '930707' then return false; end if; if p_status not in ('예약접수', '통화필요', '예약확정', '예약취소') then return false; end if; select booking_date, booking_time into target_date, target_time from public.bookings where id = p_booking_id limit 1; if target_date is null then return false; end if; if p_status = '예약취소' then delete from public.booking_slots where booking_date = target_date and booking_time = target_time and source = 'booked'; delete from public.bookings where id = p_booking_id; return true; end if; update public.bookings set booking_status = p_status where id = p_booking_id; return found; end; $$; grant execute on function public.admin_set_booking_status(bigint, text, text) to anon, authenticated; notify pgrst, 'reload schema';
